text: 11月5日，第九届虹桥国际经济论坛发布《世界开放报告2026》，报告认为世界开放正处于复杂严峻的调整期，2025年世界开放指数为0.7453，同比下降1%，为2016年以来最大降幅。诺贝尔经济学奖获得者皮萨里德斯表示，地缘政治局势和关税壁垒对贸易秩序产生负面影响，关税出台逻辑早已不是经济考量；开放极大地提高了中国人民的生活水平，中国经济正朝着正确的方向发展。报告还显示，1990年至2025年中国开放指数从0.5891上升至0.7551，提高28.18%，2025年排名较2024年上升1位、较2008年上升32位、较1990年上升50位。（央视新闻）
text_en: On November 5, the ninth Hongqiao International Economic Forum released the World Openness Report 2026. The report holds that world openness is in a complex and severe adjustment period; the 2025 World Openness Index was 0.7453, down 1% year on year, the largest decline since 2016. Nobel economics laureate Pissarides said geopolitical conditions and tariff barriers have had a negative impact on the trade order, and the logic behind tariffs is no longer economic considerations; openness has greatly raised the living standards of the Chinese people, and the Chinese economy is moving in the right direction. The report also shows that from 1990 to 2025, China's openness index rose from 0.5891 to 0.7551, an increase of 28.18%; in 2025, its ranking rose 1 place from 2024, 32 places from 2008 and 50 places from 1990. (CCTV News)
